question: In a △ABC right-angled at C, if tan A = √3, then the value of sin A cos B cot(A + B) is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ In a right-angled △ABC right-angled at C, the total sum of angles is 180°. Since ∠C = 90°, the sum of the remaining two angles must be A + B = 90°. We are required to find the value of the expression sin A × cos B × cot(A + B). By substituting A + B = 90° into the expression, we get cot(90°), which equals 0. Because any finite value multiplied by 0 results in 0, the entire expression evaluates to 0 without needing to find tan A. **∴ The correct answer is 0.**
